Specialized Cosmetic Care For Prairie Village

Prairie Village holds a high standard — from the tree-lined streets and mid-century homes to the shops at Prairie Village and Corinth Square. For cosmetic dentistry, that standard means choosing a practice that specializes in smile work, not one that fits it in between fillings.

Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry Westport specializes in exactly that. Our modern office at 638 W 39th St is an easy 15-minute drive — north on State Line Road or up Ward Parkway — with private parking so your visit starts stress-free. From custom veneers to complete smile restorations, this is dentistry designed around the result you want to see in the mirror — and yes, we handle your routine checkups and cleanings too.

The Experience

  • Modern, beautifully designed office
  • Private parking on site
  • Comfort-first care, including sedation options
  • Rated 5.0 by our patients on Google
Book An Appointment

Artistry meets dentistry

Cosmetic & Restorative Services For Prairie Village

Whether you're refining one detail or transforming your entire smile, every treatment plan is custom-designed. Prairie Village patients most often visit us for:

Porcelain Veneers

Hand-crafted veneers that correct chips, gaps, and discoloration — designed to fit your face and look completely natural.

Dental Implants

Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth that restore both the function and beauty of your smile.

Full Mouth Restoration

For bigger cases: advanced treatments combined into one plan that rebuilds your teeth's health, function, and appearance. Learn more

Crowns, Bridges & Restorative Care

Precision crowns, bridges, and dentures that repair damage and complete your smile with a seamless, high-end finish.

Why patients choose us

Higher-End Dentistry, Zero Stress

A Modern Office & Private Parking

A beautiful, thoughtfully designed space with private on-site parking — your visit is easy from the moment you arrive.

Comfort-First Care

Nitrous oxide, oral sedation, and IV sedation options so even big treatment days feel relaxed and manageable.

Cutting-Edge Technology

State-of-the-art imaging and the latest treatment technology for precise, efficient results on every case.

5.0-Star Rated

Our patients rate us 5.0 on Google — and trust us with their biggest smile transformations, not just checkups.

Come see for yourself

Take A Tour Of Our Office

From the private parking lot to the treatment rooms, everything about our Westport office was designed to make you comfortable before you ever sit in the chair.

Ready For The Smile You Actually Want?

Book your cosmetic consultation at our Westport office — a short drive from Prairie Village at 638 W 39th St, Kansas City, MO 64111. Private parking available.
